caption:
Prediction markets are really going all out with celebrity ads. Kalshi got Danny McBride and Shane Gillis for a four-minute comedy spot about weather forecasting. Branding is wild when a betting app needs a magic oracle and an Oompa Loompa to explain how it works. Would you trust a weather prediction app with your money? Let us know below.

Source: Variety

post.news: Shane Gillis and Danny McBride star in a four-minute ad for prediction market Kalshi where Gillis plays a clueless weatherman.
post.take: We used to watch TV for the weather. Now we need an Oompa Loompa and a betting app to know if it rains.
post.insight: Prediction markets are spending big on celebrity-led comedy campaigns to make betting on real-world events feel like pop culture.
